incidents.name: We are investigating connectivity issues with Desk US region
incidents.message: A Desk Enterprise database in our US region failed over to its standby and has recovered fully now.

incidents.name: We are experiencing a backlog in indexing for Search, on Desk EU region
incidents.timestamp: Jul <var data-var='date'>20</var>, <var data-var='time'>12:54</var> - Jul <var data-var='date'>21</var>, <var data-var='time'>06:41</var> UTC

incidents.name: We are experiencing a delay for inbound email to Desk US region
incidents.message: Our 3rd party email provider experienced a delay in delivering email, we are seeing email deliver in to Desk in the US region now again. We will monitor the situation.

incidents.name: Investigating Projects issues in the US region
incidents.message: A number of our Projects Application servers in the US region became unresponsive for a short time. We have rebooted the servers now. Projects is responding well, we will continue to monitor.

incidents.name: Investigating connectivity issues with a US Desk Enterprise database instance
incidents.message: Issues with a US Desk Enterprise database instance have been resolved by failing over to another availability zone.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of a slow down in our US region
incidents.message: Slow response times from with Teamwork Projects in the US region has now been resolved, we have scaled up our back end to cater for the current increased traffic.

incidents.name: Delay in inbound email to Teamwork Desk US and EU region
incidents.message: Our 3rd party provider Mailgun have resolved the issue. Inbound email delivery to Desk in the US and EU regions are delivering normally now.

incidents.name: Search facility within Desk US region is offline
incidents.message: The Search facility within Desk US region is back to normal now. Our Elasticsearch cluster failed earlier today and we used a fall back search option in the interim while we brought a new cluster up to date.

incidents.name: Teamwork Chat US Region
incidents.message: Issues affecting logging in to Teamwork Chat in the US Region have been resolved. We experienced an issue with a Message Queue System and worked to replace the faulty node. We apologize for the unplanned incident.

incidents.name: Issues with Chat login in the US region
incidents.message:
Chat in the US region has recovered and working well again now.

Earlier this morning we were upgrading some infrastructure while it was quiet and we have reverted this change now to restore functionality.

incidents.name: Website login
incidents.message: Issues with our log in option or on main website are now resolved.

incidents.name: Investigating degraded performance on one US region Projects database replica
incidents.message: The US region Projects database replica at fault has been replaced and in production serving users again.
incidents.timestamp: May <var data-var='date'>15</var>, <var data-var='time'>12:40</var> - May <var data-var='date'>16</var>, <var data-var='time'>12:57</var> UTC
